title: Open-End Agreement for Architectural & Engineering Services
short_description: Open-end A/E services framework for various Alabama governmental facility projects.
project_location: Montgomery, Alabama, USA; projects throughout the State of Alabama
project_scope: Open-end agreement for various projects at governmental facilities throughout Alabama. No specific building, structure type, size, gross floor area, span, or individual project scope is defined in the notice.
services: Architectural and engineering services under an open-end agreement, including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework/open-end agreement without technical specification for a defined project.
- Focus is general building and governmental facilities rather than a specific complex structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but alongside many unrelated disciplines.
- Notice explicitly includes rehabilitation and refurbishment, which is generally less relevant for sbp.
- No information on spans, special structures, long-span roofs, bridges, stadiums, or innovative structural challenges.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value for the open-end agreement.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee for structural engineering or sbp-relevant scope is stated. The notice only gives a total contract value of 2.0 million USD for a multi-discipline open-end agreement that may result in multiple awards.
references_qualifications: Qualifications requested from design professionals for architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.
award_criteria: RFP/RFQ requesting qualifications; specific award criteria and weighting are not stated in the provided notice.
